description: This file defines a WordLoader class that extends BufferLoader to load and parse Word documents using the officeparser library. It extracts text content and metadata, splitting the document into sections based on common patterns.

classes.name: WordLoader
classes.description: A class that loads Word documents, parses them into sections, and returns Document objects with metadata.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Asynchronously parses raw Buffer data of a Word document into an array of Document objects, extracting text and metadata.

methods.name: splitIntoSections
methods.description: Splits the document content into sections based on common patterns such as page, section, chapter headings, or separators.
